visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-width semantic table (border-collapse) in a horizontally scrollable wrapper; no stacking on mobile. Legend below.
visualCharacteristics.groupHeader: Group row: #004666, white 16px/700 uppercase, letter-spacing .05em, padding 16px 0, 2px #000 bottom border; 10px spacer column between groups.
visualCharacteristics.cells: 11.2px/1.65, padding 8.4px, centred, 1px #778081 left/bottom borders; label column left-aligned 700 without left border; column-header row 700 with a #004666 corner cell.
visualCharacteristics.highlight: Highlighted plan column: 5px #0097ce left/right borders, top on its header cell and bottom on the last row; blue text and markers.
visualCharacteristics.markers: :dot: 10px filled circle (#000), :dot-ring: 10px ring with 2px border; visually-hidden text for screen readers.
visualCharacteristics.legend: 13.2px/1.65 #888, paragraphs 13.2px apart, inline markers with a 5px gap.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Feature x plan comparison grid with grouped plan columns and a recommended plan.

tableStructure.wrapper: #service-plans-table.wrapper: width 100%, overflow-x auto, font Gotham (-> Montserrat) 16px. table width 100%, border-collapse collapse, cellpadding/cellspacing 0.
tableStructure.columns: 7 grid columns: [feature label] [WA] [EW] [SU] [spacer] [PV1] [PT]. At 1440 (1170px table): label and each plan column 192px, spacer 13px (declared 10px). Declared widths (td 80px, header row 150px) are overridden by the 100% table, so columns share space evenly.

groupHeaderRow.markup: thead tr: th(colspan 1, empty) | th.section-header colspan 3 'WARRANTY PERIOD' | th.blank (spacer) | th.section-header colspan 2 'POST-WARRANTY PERIOD'
groupHeaderRow.style: th 16px/26.4px 700, white, letter-spacing .05em (0.8px), uppercase, centred, padding 16px 0, border-bottom 2px solid #000; .section-header background #004666; first (corner) th transparent but keeps the 2px #000 bottom border; spacer th 10px, transparent, no border. Height 61px at 1440.

columnHeaderRow.markup: first tbody tr: td(empty) | 'WA - Warranty' | 'EW - Extension Warranty' | 'SU - StartUp Care*' | td.blank | 'PV1 - Preventative Plus' | 'PT - Protective'
columnHeaderRow.style: 11.2px/18.48px 700 #000 centred, padding 8.4px; the empty label cell background #004666 (white text); highlighted PT cell gets border-top 5px solid #0097ce and black text. Height 38px at 1440.

tableStructure.cellStyle: td 11.2px (0.7em)/18.48px #000, padding 8.4px (0.75em), centred, border-left 1px solid #778081, border-bottom 1px solid #778081. Label column (first): left-aligned, 700, no left border. PV1 column (right of spacer): no left border. Spacer td: padding 0, no borders. Values 400. One-line rows 36px, two-line labels 55px at 1440.
tableStructure.markers: dot = div.circle: 10x10, radius 10px, #000, display block, margin auto. ring = div.whiteCircle on source (UNSTYLED - live bug, renders nothing); intended style is the stylesheet's .emptycircle: 10x10, radius 10px, 2px solid #000, transparent. Text values ('10% Off', '10% off') are plain cell text (case as on source).
tableStructure.highlightedColumn: PT (7th grid column): every body cell border-left 5px + border-right 5px solid #0097ce, text #0097ce (so '10% off' is blue), dots #0097ce, ring border #0097ce; column-header cell adds border-top 5px #0097ce, text stays #000 and 700. Intended border-bottom 5px #0097ce on the last row is never applied live (bug: rule targets tr:nth-child(15), table has 12 rows) -> column is open at the bottom live; recommend closing it.
tableStructure.legend: div.footnotes inside the wrapper: 13.2px (0.825em)/21.78px #888; first p is empty ( ) and only adds spacing (p margins 13.2px 0); then p: inline-block 10px black dot directly followed by 'included' (no gap); p: 'optional at additional charge' with an unstyled span.whiteCircle (no symbol shown live; should show the ring). Legend top 12px below the table at 1440.
tableStructure.mobile: No stacking: the wrapper scrolls horizontally (overflow-x auto). At 390 the wrapper is 374px wide, the table's min-content width 478px; group header text wraps (87px tall), column headers wrap to 4 lines (74px), label column ~102px, plan columns 61-90px. Breadcrumb hidden, section padding 15.6px 7.8px.

contentPattern.structure: xwalk container: three single-cell block-field rows (groups, highlight, legend), then one row per Plan Row item with 7 cells [label, plan1..plan6]. First item = column headers. Cell values ':dot:' / ':dot-ring:' / text / empty. Plan columns empty in all rows are dropped.

reuseGuidance: Use for any mybeckman.in service-plan comparison (1-6 plans, grouped columns, optional highlighted plan). Keep the legend in the block.
